title: Setting a shop name you will keep
target: How to rename a TCG Card Shop Simulator shop at the billboard, using the sequence the game runs rather than looking for a settings menu.
version: no version stated by this build (see the sources page)
prerequisites: A moment when you are not serving
A name you have actually decided on

steps.do: Set the shop name early rather than late.
steps.because: the billboard carries a renaming sequence of its own (ShopRenamer)

steps.do: Confirm the name rather than walking off partway through.
steps.because: renaming runs through an opening, a name and a confirmation screen (m_ConfirmNameScreen)

steps.do: Type it into the box the billboard gives you.
steps.because: the name is entered into its own input (m_SetNameInput)

steps.do: Check what the sign shows once you are done.
steps.because: the billboard displays the current shop name (m_ShopName)

steps.do: Come back to the billboard if you want to change it again.
steps.because: the billboard is a placed object in the shop (InteractableShopBillboard)

commonMistakes: Leaving the shop on a default name.
Looking for the name in a settings screen instead of the billboard.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
